🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — November 15, 2026

Moon, in Aquarius, holds a sextile to Neptune, in Aries. Nothing in common except the angle they hold: the worth of a thing and the account of it briefly coincide.

Easier — Reviewing, sorting, naming what a thing is worth to you.
Harder — Mistaking an easy day for a free one.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus hold a 3-week sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars, your ruler, crosses Leo with no title of its own. From Aquarius, Moon hands you an opening. Cardinal fire: beginning costs almost nothing. After two weeks of the same angle, the terms are familiar.

♉ TAURUS
Venus rules you from its own Libra. Moon in Aquarius stands at a right angle: friction, and a clear number. Fixed earth pays to hold on. Three weeks of this, and none of it is news.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury, your ruler, crosses Scorpio untitled. From Aquarius, Moon makes it easy, which is not the same as right. Air bends, and bending costs nothing here. The conjunction of a week ago is off it now.

♋ CANCER
Moon, your ruler, holds no rank in Aquarius and simply works. From Libra, Venus sets a figure against the wanting. Cardinal water: the beginning has a price on it. Mercury let go of it a week ago.

♌ LEO
Sun, your ruler, moves through Scorpio unannounced. Moon faces you from Aquarius, holding the other figures. Fire that holds on, charged for holding. The Libra chapter closed four weeks ago.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury rules you from Scorpio, untitled. Sun in Scorpio opens a gap you have to step into. Mutable earth: two answers, neither expensive. Mercury went direct a week ago; the re-reading is over.

♎ LIBRA
Venus governs you, at home in Libra. Moon trines you from Aquarius, and what you hold finds words unforced. Air begins, and beginning asks little today. Venus has been out of Scorpio for four weeks now.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, is only passing through Leo. From Aquarius, Moon cuts across the appetite. Water keeps its grip past the point it is worth. The hold Mercury had two weeks ago is not there any more.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter governs you, untitled in Leo. Moon in Aquarius makes room for you, and then waits. Mutable fire keeps two accounts, and both balance. Two weeks in, and the shape of it is no longer a surprise.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn rules you, fallen in Aries. Sun sextiles you from Scorpio: an opening to be reached for. Cardinal earth: the opening move is the cheap one. It has held three weeks without changing its terms.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn governs you from Aries, where it stands lowest. Moon is inside your sign, at arm’s length. Fixed air: the holding and the held stop differing. The trine to Moon that held two weeks ago has let go.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter, your ruler, is only passing through Leo. From Scorpio, Sun concedes the point early. Water that changes shape, and the shape fits. Three weeks ago Jupiter was still held by Moon; that is finished.
